name: VAT on construction work
name_hu: Az építőipari munka általános forgalmi adója
review_status: Drawn from public statutory sources. Pending review by a Hungarian quantity surveyor before it is relied on for a tender.
references: 2007. évi CXXVII. törvény az általános forgalmi adóról
description: The standard rate is 27 percent, the highest in the European Union, which makes the gross line on a Hungarian summary sheet a very different number from the net one and makes getting the rate right worth more than usual. A reduced rate applies to specified new residential property. Construction and installation services between taxable persons fall under the domestic reverse charge, where the customer accounts for the tax and the invoice carries no VAT at all.

rates.applies_to: specified new residential property, subject to the conditions in force
reverse charge: the customer accounts for the tax, the invoice shows none

practice_notes: The reduced rate has moved more than once and carries conditions and end dates; confirm it against the rate in force for the project
Reverse charge is a rule about who accounts for the tax, not a rule about the work being untaxed
The summary sheet applies VAT after the contingency, not before
